commands.description: Places a copy of a prefab at a world position. Placing the player prefab when a player exists moves that player instead.
commands.name: scene.spawn

commands.description: Fills a rectangle of grid cells (inclusive) with a tile prefab, replacing whatever tiles were there.
commands.name: scene.paintRect

commands.description: Removes an entity from the scene.
commands.name: entity.delete

commands.description: Turns an entity: a flat (top-down) image by quarter turns clockwise (negative: back), e.g. a road piece or a rug; an upright picture (a house, a cart) mirrors when turns is odd, since it has only one side to show. Recorded as an override on prefab copies.
commands.name: entity.turn

commands.description: Flips an entity's image left-right, so upright art (a house, a cart, a character) faces the other way. Use it to face doors and carts toward a road or for variety; mirroring twice undoes it.
commands.name: entity.mirror

commands.description: Saves an entity as a new prefab (prefabs/<name>.prefab); the entity becomes its first copy.
commands.name: prefab.createFromEntity

commands.description: Makes a prefab from an image asset (development_plan.md 6.3): a ground tile (painted onto cells, lying flat) or a prop (placed, upright). Size props by the asset's analysis: "cells" is how many grid cells wide it should be; 0 sizes it by its pack's scale. Saved as prefabs/<name>.prefab.
commands.name: prefab.create

params.description: Prefab path under prefabs/, without .prefab: letters, digits, - _ and /.
params.name: name

params.description: true: a ground tile; false: a prop.
params.name: tile

params.description: Tiles: blocks movement. Props: blocks its cell.
params.name: solid

params.description: Props: width in grid cells (0 = by the pack's scale).
params.name: cells

commands.description: Paints a rectangle of cells with a terrain (e.g. dirt for a village square) and lets the engine pick every tile, edges and corners included, from the analyzed ground tiles. Use the terrain names in the assets' "edges".
commands.name: terrain.paintRect

params.description: The terrain to paint, e.g. dirt.
params.name: terrain

params.description: What surrounds it, e.g. grass; empty for the usual.
params.name: background

commands.description: Lays a road (or a river) through points, along the grid, and lets the engine pick every tile: straights, corners, ends and junctions match their neighbours. Use the terrain names in the assets' "edges".
commands.name: terrain.paintPath

params.description: The terrain to lay, e.g. dirt.
params.name: terrain

params.description: What surrounds it, e.g. grass; empty for the usual.
params.name: background

params.description: The cells it passes through, in order: "x,y;x,y;...".
params.name: points

commands.description: Replaces every copy of one prefab in the scene with another, each where it was, keeping how it was turned and mirrored (so a fence piece mirrored for the other isometric direction stays so), and which built place it belongs to. Use it for any 'replace all X with Y'. For ground tiles, use terrain.replace.
commands.name: prefab.replace

params.description: The prefab now in the scene, e.g. prefabs/placeholders/fence-fence.prefab.
params.name: from

params.description: The prefab to put in its place, e.g. prefabs/a-diagonal-fence.prefab.
params.name: to

params.description: keep (as each copy was turned and mirrored), mirror (the other way), or none.
params.name: orient

commands.description: Replaces one thing in the scene with a copy of another prefab, where it was, keeping how it was turned and mirrored and which built place it belongs to (the viewport's and the Inspector's Replace prefab). For every copy of a prefab, use prefab.replace.
commands.name: entity.replacePrefab

params.description: The prefab to put in its place, e.g. prefabs/a-cart.prefab.
params.name: to

commands.description: Replaces one ground tile with another everywhere: hand-painted tiles and a built place's ground (its tile layers) alike, however many cells. Use it for 'use grass in place of cobble'.
commands.name: terrain.replace

params.description: The tile prefab now on the ground, e.g. prefabs/generated/tile-terrain-cobble-1-seamless.prefab.
params.name: from

params.description: The tile prefab to use instead.
params.name: to

commands.description: Creates or replaces a Lua script (see docs/systems/scripting.md for the API scripts can use). Attach it with a LuaScript component. Scripts are the game's behaviour: they run while playing, never while editing, so never write one to change the scene (use the scene commands: scene.spawn, entity.delete, prefab.replace, terrain.replace).
commands.name: script.write

commands.description: Creates or replaces a World Bible entry (canon: characters, factions, locations, items, events, lore, style).
commands.name: world.write

params.description: character, faction, location, item, event, lore or style.
params.name: kind

params.description: File name: lowercase letters, digits, - and _ (empty: made from the name).
params.name: id

params.description: Links to other entries, '; '-separated, each '<type> <kind>/<id>', e.g. 'lives_in location/brookvale; member_of faction/iron-guild' (may be empty).
params.name: relations

params.description: Locations only: the scene that shows this place, scenes/<name>.aige (optional).
params.name: scene

commands.description: Adds a named place (a Marker) that schedules can send people to, e.g. herb_garden. Invisible in play. Use a free, walkable cell.
commands.name: scene.addMarker

params.description: Lowercase letters, digits and _, e.g. village_well.
params.name: name

commands.description: Builds a dungeon in a rectangle of grid cells: rooms joined by corridors, walled in, every room reachable, with enemies (more of them further from the start) and pickups. Everything already in the area except the player is replaced. Deterministic: the same seed gives the same level. Pick an area away from what should stay (see the tile bounds).
commands.name: level.generate

params.description: Any number; change it for a different layout.
params.name: seed

params.description: How many rooms to try to fit.
params.name: rooms

params.description: 0-1: extra corridors so not every path is a dead end.
params.name: loops

params.description: Tile prefab for the floor, e.g. prefabs/stone_floor.prefab.
params.name: floor

params.description: Solid tile prefab for the walls, e.g. prefabs/wall.prefab.
params.name: wall

params.description: Pickup prefab (e.g. a potion); empty for none.
params.name: pickup

params.description: Move the player to the start room.
params.name: movePlayer

commands.description: Builds a whole village from the pack's analyzed prefabs: streets laid with fitted road tiles, a square with a well, houses on plots facing the streets (sized from the house art), fenced gardens, decorations by the doors, banners at the entrances, a landmark (tower, windmill), and trees, bushes and rocks around the edge. It grows right and down from (x0,y0); its size follows from the number of houses. Everything already in the area except the player is replaced. Deterministic: the same seed gives the same village. Use this for any village or town instead of placing pieces one by one.
commands.name: level.village

params.description: How many houses: 4-8 a hamlet, 10-20 a village, 25+ a town.
params.name: houses

params.description: Any number; change it for a different layout.
params.name: seed

params.description: 0-1: how many trees, bushes and rocks.
params.name: nature

params.description: Fence the gardens behind the houses.
params.name: fences

params.description: A square with a well where the main streets cross.
params.name: square

params.name: ground

params.description: Road terrain, e.g. dirt; empty = found.
params.name: road

params.description: Move the player onto the main street.
params.name: movePlayer
